structure.unit: Organization, Admission and Licensing of Insurers

law.catch_line: Enjoining unlicensed foreign or alien insurers from transacting the business of insurance in Commonwealth

text.section: Process may be served in accordance with § 13.1-758 or in any other manner prescribed by law.

This section shall not apply to any nonprofit life insurance or annuity company which is organized and operated for the purpose of issuing insurance and annuity contracts, exclusively to or for the benefit of nonprofit educational or scientific institutions and individuals engaged in the service of those institutions. The clerk of the Commission shall be considered the attorney for service of process in this Commonwealth for all of such insurer's policy and contract holders in this Commonwealth. The appointment shall (i) be irrevocable, (ii) bind the insurer and any successors in interest, and (iii) remain in effect as long as there is in force in this Commonwealth any contract made by the insurer or any obligation arising from the contract.
Nothing in this section shall apply to nonprofit Railroad Brotherhood or other similar fraternal organizations.
